g.text: Big markets and intensive ones are mostly different countries

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: each country's share of Claude conversations against its usage per working-age person. The index published

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: on its own hides that the highest-indexing countries are small; the volume ranking on its own hides that the largest are

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Anthropic's published Economic Index data documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Both axes are log-scaled: shares span three orders of magnitude and the index two. A country high and to the left is small but

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: intensive; low and to the right is large but thin. The United States is the only country that is both large and well above

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: proportional. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and Max consumer plans plus Cowork; Anthropic's API traffic is a separate file and is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: not included here. A cell Anthropic did not publish is absent, not zero: a value is released only where it clears an aggregation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: threshold and a geography sample floor.
